Famous error
2023 Quarter Errors & Values
The 2023 American Women quarters (Bessie Coleman, Edith Kanakaʻole and others) are modern copper-nickel coins worth face value in circulation — but error collectors hunt them for off-center strikes, die cracks, clipped planchets and doubled dies, which can sell for meaningful premiums.
Key facts
Standard 2023 quarters are clad, no silver — worth 25 cents.
Sought errors: off-center strikes, broadstrikes, die breaks/“cuds”, clipped planchets, and doubled-die varieties.
Condition and the dramatic-ness of the error drive value; certified examples sell best.
Silver proof versions exist in Mint sets (90% silver since 2019).
